headline: Per-share earnings flat on the quarter, higher on the year
summary_short: EPS was BRL 0.64, unchanged from the prior quarter and up 8.5% from BRL 0.59 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It was flat q/q and rose 8.5% y/y. No revenue, margin, credit or capital figures were available from the shard, and no drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
